title: One URL per page
why: Repeated slashes, `/index.html` and `?page=1` published the same page twice.
changelog: `<meta seo query="page">`: `?page=1` redirects to the base and a non-page value is a 404
`//route`, `/a//b` and `/route/index.html` get one 301 in `brain start`; the static server collapses `/a//b` and `/route/index.html` and answers 400 to a leading `//`
